items.title: Carvana Soared 27% in the Week Ending Nov. 2 After Its First 200,000-Car Quarter: “The Moat Is Widening”
items.summary: Key TakeawaysCarvana (CVNA) stock surged 27% from October 26 through November 2 after reporting record quarterly retail sales of 217,385 vehicles, up 39% year over year.
